shots.intent: 搜索列表首图，用干净双机立姿一眼点进来
一秒交代整机结构与可换防风帽、背夹、接口形态
放大手机自带麦远距离收音发糊、风噪人声不清的痛点
用同机位双栏波形疏密差证明降噪，不写任何数值主张
代入户外开拍场景，证明接收端直插手机即可录
展示双人各自佩戴同录的使用方式，完成身份代入
铺开设播客、探店、教学、演出等用途面，扩大受众自认
用绒毛与机身肩线微距证明做工与风噪处理
交底随附配件与适配面，消除到手落差风险

style.backgroundSystem: snow-white seamless field for the packshot, warm oatmeal concentric-arc panels for benefit and info screens, muted real environments for scene screens
style.direction: professional audio-gear ecommerce, creator-grade and clean
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and empty rounded chip frames, one accent colour, no filled pictograms
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused key from the front-left, restrained rim sweep, gentle contact shadows, neutral studio grade, no harsh specular bursts
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent professional audio-gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of snow-white #FFFFFF, warm oatmeal #F2ECE4, graphite #2A2A2C and mist silver #9AA9B2; neutral studio grade lighting with a soft diffused front-left key, restrained rim sweep and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin single-weight line icons and empty rounded chip frames only; matte anodised product bodies with fine surface texture and one controlled specular roll; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic scaffolding; stable slight 3/4 to straight-on product scale and centring; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no rendered in-image copy, badges or model numbers
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 to straight-on product scale, collars and connector edges always readable, never overlapped by props or hands
style.surfaceSystem: matte graphite product bodies on oatmeal board and light-stone counters, deep graphite surface for macro
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif held in the style system only, every glyph area left blank for post-composited copy
